intuition.title: Substrate selection is qualified
intuition.text: FTO deposits are predominantly calcite with (104) parallel to the substrate. Bare-glass deposits and solution precipitates instead contain calcite, vaterite and aragonite; their Mg feed and physical batch crosswalk are unspecified. SnO2 diffraction belongs to the substrate. Lattice matching is proposed, while the selective nucleation mechanism remains unclear.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
